rules.sentence: Small folliculocentric keratotic nodules can be found in cases of keratosis pilaris, where papules are centered on small hair follicles, and it can be associated with erythema.
Scaling is an important finding in cases of hyperkeratosis.
Lichenification is a thickening of the skin and results from chronic injuries such as repetitive scratching.
